### CI/CD & Workflow Improvements
#1951 repoints boundary validation to omnibase_core with failing-fixture test. #1667 bumps two reusable workflows. #1321 updates actions/checkout@v7, actions/cache@v6, onex_change_control. #1579 routes same-repo PRs to self-hosted for validate-docs via fork-aware selector. #1028 standardizes core runner routing across gates/selectors. #1016 adds call-reject-skip.yml for merge_group skip-token re-scan. #3786 runs omnimarket's PR-title node. #1577 pushes sync-main via onexbot-occ-writer app token. #2920 scopes eight pre-commit hooks to staged files.

### Core Infrastructure & SPI
#1361 logs heartbeat-loop warnings with traceback. #1014 appends HANDOFF_NUDGE bit to EnumHookBit. #257 relocates 13 hardcoded topics to registry/event_registry.py with named constants. #170 moves ProtocolDomainPlugin to omnibase_spi.protocols.runtime; removes dead modules. #32 adds 168+ node/handler protocol tests. #1337 requires event_model on command-category handler_routing entries. #1253 deletes dead onex.runtime.intents topic and publisher. #1471 unifies ProtocolSemVer in types/type_semver.py. #123 removes Consul references from protocol parser, registry, docstrings.

### Omnimarket Features & Fixes
#3767 replaces I9 prompt with is_even code task; new test fails old corpus, passes new. #3674 adds four throughput-tick rules (long park, unread host, never-ran lane, rising opens). #3728 adds six typed gateway reads (workflow_runs, run_jobs, job_log_tail, artifacts, pr_text, releases) with request fields/defaults. #3736 adds automation run observer for receipts/cron/launchd evidence. #3563 adds CONTRACT_IN_ANOTHER_REPO verdict via contract-home marker. #3810 adds Codex headroom reporting separate from Claude limits. #3815 protects "dev" head; validates head_ref_name; force-with-lease push; polish off kernel loop. #2900 deploy effect publishes rebuild command, avoids 600s deadline. #3275 declares six forthcoming attempt lineage keys for consumer-first compatibility. #3739 dod_verify compares live Linear criteria hashes; refuses on drift. #3417 adds alert-channel liveness projection. #2980 adds companion seam for PR landing workflow.
